mapper.select: SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT p.prj_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,p.stlm_mthd_cd,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT s.bill_stg_id,s.prj_id,s.stg_odr_no,s.bill_stg_nm,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt,s.created_at FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.bill_stg_id=#{id}

SELECT FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.amnd_yn='N'
AND b.bill_stg_id=#{stageId} AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL' AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRM')
ORDER BY b.bill_odr_no,b.bill_id
mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,b.bill_no,b.prj_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name, p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt,b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt,b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.rcpt_plan_dt, coalesce(r.received_amt,0)::bigint AS received_amt, (b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.adjustment,0))::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt, CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.amnd_yn='N' THEN greatest(0,b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.adjustment,0)-coalesce(r.received_amt,0))::bigint ELSE 0::bigint END AS receivable_amt, CASE WHEN b.rcpt_plan_dt IS NULL OR b.bill_stts_cd!='CONFIRM' OR b.amnd_yn!='N' OR b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.adjustment,0)-coalesce(r.received_amt,0)<=0 THEN NULL WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt>=60 THEN 3 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt>=30 THEN 2 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt>=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reminder_stage, CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' THEN b.bill_dt WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN coalesce(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt,b.created_at::date) ELSE to_date(b.atrb_ym||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') END AS effective_date FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.rcpt_amt)::bigint AS received_amt FROM bill.rcpt x WHERE x.bill_id=b.bill_id) r ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.tot_amt)::bigint AS adjustment FROM bill.bill x WHERE x.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND x.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM') a ON true WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('TK','MO','DP')

UNION ALL SELECT NULL::bigint AS bill_id,s.bill_stg_id,true AS virtual_plan,NULL::varchar AS bill_no, p.prj_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,NULL::varchar AS atrb_ym,NULL::date AS bill_dt, s.sply_amt,0::bigint AS vat_amt,s.sply_amt AS tot_amt,'PLAN'::varchar AS bill_stts_cd, NULL::varchar AS txinv_no,NULL::date AS txinv_dt,NULL::date AS rcpt_plan_dt, 0::bigint AS received_amt,0::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt,0::bigint AS receivable_amt, NULL::integer AS reminder_stage,coalesce(s.bill_plan_dt,s.created_at::date) AS effective_date FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL')
mapper.select: SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,n.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym,d.mm_qty, NULL::numeric AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty,d.ovtm_tm_qty, d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=d.cntrct_dev_id WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT concat(h.clmn_nm,': ',coalesce(h.bfr_val,'없음'),' → ',coalesce(h.aft_val,'없음')) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm IN ('bill.bill','bill.bill_dtl') AND h.obj_rec_id=cast(#{id} AS text) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id,n.dev_nm AS display_name, a.asgn_se_cd,m.mm_qty,u.bill_untprc_amt AS untprc_amt,t.atnd_id,t.work_day_qty,t.rglr_tm_qty, t.ovtm_tm_qty,t.mth_work_day_qty FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt<=greatest(#{start},a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt<=#{end} AND a.end_dt>=#{start} ORDER BY a.asgn_id
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill SET bill_dt=#{header.bill_dt},sply_amt=#{header.sply_amt},vat_amt=#{header.vat_amt}, txinv_no=#{header.txinv_no},txinv_dt=#{header.txinv_dt},rcpt_plan_dt=#{header.rcpt_plan_dt}, rmrk_desc=#{header.rmrk_desc},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE bill_id=#{header.bill_id} AND bill_stts_cd='DRAFT'
